01_PlotLinegraphs.Legend_Text: Points: individual samples; markers/line: mean; shaded band: mean +/- SD. Y axis: fold change of the percentage of cells above threshold relative to the baseline (NoTreat 0 hr) mean. Stars: post-hoc comparison of each time point with NoTreat at 0 hr (welch_holm; welch_holm = pairwise Welch t-tests with Holm adjustment, dunnett = Dunnett's test), adjusted within each treatment and marker; omnibus test across time points: welch. * p < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001. Samples per time point: 3-4 (1: 3-4; 2: 3-4; 4: 3-4; 18: 3-4). n counts independent culture wells (samples); the 3-4 samples per group come from 3 litters (Statistics_litters.csv); samples are treated as independent. Marker shapes and line types identify the clusters (1: circle, 2: triangle, 4: diamond, 18: square). Lines start at the shared NoTreat 0 hr baseline (the other treatments have no separate 0 hr sample).
